statement: If a declared resource window changes only the accessible readout by the same stochastic post-processing of a fixed microscopic QM experiment, PDT and QM accessible outcome probabilities are identical. A same-input quantitative deviation therefore requires an additional physical or probabilistic modification, not resource quotienting alone.
corollary: Total-variation distinguishability cannot increase under stochastic readout coarse-graining.
prior_art_status: underlying stochastic post-processing/data-processing mathematics established; no historical novelty claimed
